episodes.title: Operation Jericho: FBI Captures Yahweh Ben Yahweh in New Orleans
episodes.description:
A decapitated body in Miami exposes a violent cult and launches a nationwide FBI hunt. This episode follows the case from Aston Green’s murder to Operation Jericho.

When a construction foreman found 25-year-old Aston Green beheaded on a dirt road in 1981, detectives uncovered ties to a growing sect led by Hulon Mitchell, known to followers as Yahweh Ben Yahweh. As fear silenced witnesses, another attack struck: dissident member Carlton Carey was shot dead and his wife, Mildred Banks, barely survived a shooting and machete slashing. With intimidation rampant, local police turned to the FBI.

Agents traced the sect’s expanding footprint from Miami to 13 states, its businesses, strict doctrine, and ruthless enforcement. A firebombing in Delray, Florida, the strong-arm takeover of the “Dirt Road Apartments,” and ritual-style killings deepened the probe. The arrest of former NFL player Robert Rozier became a turning point: prints linked him to multiple murders, including Raymond Kelly, whose ears had been cut off. After Yahweh Ben Yahweh publicly excommunicated Rozier, the enforcer flipped, telling agents about murders ordered to prove loyalty and bring back an ear as proof.

Despite public relations efforts and civic praise for property cleanups, insiders and protected witnesses began to talk. Prosecutors and agents traveled the country to corroborate Rozier’s account, tying the leader to extortion, conspiracy, and murder in aid of racketeering.

In November 1990, the FBI executed Operation Jericho, a coordinated multi-city raid. Agents seized Yahweh Ben Yahweh at a New Orleans hotel while teams across the South arrested his lieutenants without bloodshed. In 1992, a jury convicted Mitchell and key followers of conspiracy, ending a reign built on fear, coercion, and murder masked as faith. This is the inside story of the investigation that brought a self-proclaimed messiah to justice.
